name: Documentation report
about: Report inaccurate, unclear, missing, or unsupported project documentation
title: ""
labels: "documentation"
assignees: ""
---

## Documentation location

Identify the file and heading.

## Issue

Describe the inaccurate, unclear, missing, or unsupported statement.

## Supporting evidence

Link to the committed source file, named screenshot, or historical log that supports the correction. If reproducing behavior, provide the ROS distribution, clean-workspace context, exact command, and complete relevant output.

## Proposed wording

Provide concise replacement wording when possible.

## Claim boundary

Confirm that the proposed documentation does not imply verified launch success, MoveIt, control, hardware readiness, or physical behavior without direct evidence.

## Asset provenance

If the change references a mesh, image, or derived asset, state its source and usage rights.
